title: Hive Mind Workflow Extension Frontmatter
description: Required frontmatter on every workflow-extension file under the path declared by `extensions.workflows` in hive.yml. Validates the structural contract only; the body conventions (dispatch-table row, disambiguation, routing-vs-mechanics split) are specified in `references/authoring-workflow-extensions.md` and checked by Audit mode Step 5.

layer.description: Always `PROTOCOL`. Workflow extensions govern agent routing, so they are protocol surface — changes go via CODEOWNERS PR, never the inbox or Parliament.

type.description: Discriminator. Operate mode Step 4 loads only files carrying this type from the declared extensions path; anything else in the directory is ignored with a warning.

workflow.description: Dispatch-table name for this workflow. Must match the filename stem (e.g. `standup` in `standup.md`) and must not collide with an upstream workflow name (ask, status, contribute, parliament, audit, brief, deposit) — extensions are additive, never overrides.

description.description: One-line summary: what the workflow does and which knowledge file it delegates mechanics to. Used by agents to decide whether to load this file.

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 date of most recent update.

codeowners.description: GitHub usernames who approve changes to this extension. Usually a subset of the Hive's `hive.yml` codeowners — the person who owns the workflow, not the whole Hive.

classification.description: Classification of the content in this file. Optional by default; required when the Hive's `hive.yml` sets `classification.marking_required: true`. Must not exceed the Hive's `classification.max_level`.

delegates_to.description: Optional explicit list of `knowledge/**` paths this extension delegates mechanics to. Makes the routing-vs-mechanics split machine-checkable: Audit can flag a delegated path that no longer exists.
